funding_types.quote: It’s available as a repayable loan with competitive interest rates and repayment terms.

max_amount.text: Up to $150,000 (as the CBDC office pages describe it)
max_amount.quote: The CBDC Youth Loan offers up to $150,000 in financing for rural Atlantic Canadian entrepreneurs aged 18–34

criteria.text: A youth borrower in rural Atlantic Canada (which includes Newfoundland and Labrador)
criteria.quote: Available to Youth Borrowers in rural Atlantic Canada aged 18-34;

criteria.text: A sole proprietorship, limited company or partnership, controlled by the new entrepreneur
criteria.quote: Eligible borrowers may be a sole proprietorship, a limited company or a partnership (majority of the care and control must reside with the new entrepreneur);
Available to Youth Borrowers in rural Atlantic Canada aged 18-34;

criteria.text: The business won't hurt existing businesses in the area
criteria.quote: The intended business operations must not have a negative impact on existing area businesses.

criteria.text: Your local CBDC offers this loan (programs vary by region)
criteria.quote: Programs and services delivered by CBDCs may vary by region.

research.notes: Age: the page's 18 to 34 differs from our profile's "young person (18 to 39)", so it is check-this-yourself, not an ownership rule (API §4). The loan page states no maximum; the CBDC Central office page (a source of this record) says the Youth Loan "offers up to $150,000", which is quoted for max_amount. Structure as the First Time Entrepreneur Loan, with not-registered unclear. Intake: not stated. Contacts: the offices of CBDC Central (Grand Falls-Windsor), CBDC Gander Area and CBDC Emerald (Baie Verte, with a Springdale satellite office), each quoted from its own cbdc.ca office page saved as a source of this record; all three pages list this loan. Only the Gander Area page names the places it serves (a list of place names, not census divisions), so census_divisions is null for every office and there is no location rule beyond the province (contract question B). Other CBDCs in the province are not listed as contacts. Office labels name the office and its town only, every word of which is in the contact's own quote (DECISIONS #25); the app's line above several contacts tells an owner to call the office nearest them.
